mapper.select: SELECT source_type, source_id, relative_path, owner_hint FROM ( SELECT 'TEAM_IMAGE' AS source_type, id AS source_id, NULLIF(TRIM(imageUrl), '') AS relative_path, userId AS owner_hint FROM team_page_images WHERE imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(imageUrl) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'BANNER', id, NULLIF(TRIM(imageUrl), ''), NULL FROM banner WHERE imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(imageUrl) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'NEWS', id, NULLIF(TRIM(imageUrl), ''), NULL FROM news WHERE imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(imageUrl) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'USER', id, NULLIF(TRIM(imageUrl), ''), id FROM `user` WHERE imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(imageUrl) <> '' ) references_to_images ORDER BY source_type, source_id

SELECT 'COURSE_COVER' AS source_type, id AS source_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cover_path), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(thumbnail_url), '')) AS relative_path, uploader_user_id AS owner_hint FROM course_detail WHERE status = 1 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cover_path), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(thumbnail_url), '')) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
